items.t: Tyson Stock At $59: Is Immigration Raising Your Grocery Bill?
items.sum: Pick up a pack of ground beef this weekend and look at the sticker. In October, beef prices at the store rose 0.9% in a single month, more than twice the 0.4% rise in all consumer prices. Here is the odd part: the company that packs much of that beef is losing money on it.
